idea-plugin.name: DSA Terms Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Reads your terms-of-service markdown and names every DSA duty it is missing, by article number.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → DSA Terms Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 18 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/dsa-terms-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/dsa-terms-lint

action.text: DSA Terms Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run DSA Terms Lint on the file in the editor
